Medhaṅkara teruṇṇāṃse
or ºVanaratnaº (13th Cent.). Bud. scholar of Ceylon, resident of Parivena built by King Vijayabāhu; lived in the time of Bhuvanaikabāhū I; disciple of Sumaṅgala Mahā Thera of Dhūma Droṇī Vihāra.
See Pāli Lit. Ceylon p. 230.
--Jinacarita. in 473 v.. Colombo p. 57. Colombo D. I. 1041.
Pt.. (1) Pāli Text Society, London, 1882-1906. (2) with Hindi transl. by Candramani Vidyalankara Kangri, 1916.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28, 17. 631.
--Prayogasiddhi. Pāli gr.
C.. Prayogasiddhi.
See Pāli Lit. & Lang. p. 54; also Pali Lit. Ceylon, p. 230. [Page161-b]

Medhaṅkara Mahāthera
or ºSaṅgharāja (14th Cent.). of Sovaṇṇamayamahāvihāra in Ceylon; descendent of Pasaṭha Mahāthera of Ceylon; teacher of King Milinda, wrote a. the instance of Queen-Mother Subhadrā, mother of the king of Ratnapurī.
--Lokappadīpakasāra or Lokadīpasāra, written in Burma. Colombo D. I. 1096. Fausboll 134.
See Wint., HIL. II. p. 214; also Pāli Lit. & Lang, p. 45.
